### 🚨 Critical Step: Supabase SQL Setup
Open your **Supabase Dashboard**, go to the **SQL Editor**, and paste/run this code. **This is mandatory to fix the "Balance Column" error.**

```sql
-- 1. Create the Profiles table with correct columns
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS profiles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT auth.uid(),
  username TEXT,
  phone TEXT UNIQUE,
  email TEXT UNIQUE,
  password TEXT,
  balance NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
  vip_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  total_deposit NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
  total_bet NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
  invite_code TEXT UNIQUE,
  invited_by TEXT,
  wager_required NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
  is_bank_bound BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  is_upi_bound BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  is_telegram_joined BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  bank_details JSONB,
  upi_details JSONB,
  avatar TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- 2. Create the Transactions table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id),
  amount NUMERIC NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL, -- DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, etc.
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'SUCCESS',
  desc TEXT,
  utr TEXT,
  method TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- 3. Create Game History table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_history (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES profiles(id),
  game TEXT NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC NOT NULL,
  win NUMERIC DEFAULT 0,
  details TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- 4. Function to safely update balance (Prevents UI glitches)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION increment_balance(
  user_id UUID, 
  amount_to_add NUMERIC,
  tx_type TEXT,
  tx_desc TEXT
) RETURNS VOID AS $$
BEGIN
  UPDATE profiles 
  SET balance = balance + amount_to_add,
      total_bet = CASE WHEN amount_to_add < 0 THEN total_bet + ABS(amount_to_add) ELSE total_bet END,
      wager_required = CASE WHEN amount_to_add < 0 THEN GREATEST(0, wager_required - ABS(amount_to_add)) ELSE wager_required END
  WHERE id = user_id;

  INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, amount, type, desc, status)
  VALUES (user_id, ABS(amount_to_add), tx_type, tx_desc, 'SUCCESS');
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- 5. Enable RLS (Optional, for security)
ALTER TABLE profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Public profiles are viewable by everyone." ON profiles FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile." ON profiles FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id);
```

Once you run this SQL, the "Balance" column error will disappear, and you will be able to Register and Login with the Email ID successfully.
